description: Remove EXIF and location. Strip the camera model, the date and — most importantly — the coordinates from a photo. JPEG and PNG are cleaned byte by byte, so the picture itself is not touched. Accepts image/*, .heic, .heif, .avif; up to 50 MB per file.

keepIcc.description: Keep the colour profile. It holds nothing personal, and without it colours shift on screen

outputDir.description: Where to put the results. Defaults to the folder each source file came from. Existing files are never overwritten.

paths.description: Paths to the files to process, absolute or relative to the working directory.

name: image_metadata
